blocks.text: Fossil has always been inspired by American creativity and ingenuity. Since 1984, we've strived to bring new life into the industry by making quality, fashionable watches and accessories that were both fun and accessible. Among women's wrist watches, this Fossil design stands out as an analog fashion watch with reliable quartz movement, created for anyone who wants to stay on time while expressing effortless style. Used for timekeeping yet equally suited to fashion, this women’s watch lets you tell time at a glance and look elegant without compromise. With such balanced form and function, it remains one of the most versatile watches for women Fossil offers, proving that ingenuity can be both practical and stylish.

items.label: SLIM REFINED STYLE
items.value: A flawless essential, our refined Jacqueline puts a sophisticated spin on a ladylike classic; its signature steel case pairs with an easy-to-wear leather strap in this essential design and modernizes this Fossil watch for women

items.label: SCRATCH-RESISTANT LENS
items.value: 36mm case, 14mm band width, hardened mineral crystal lens resists scratches, accurate Quartz movement with 3-hand day-date analog display, imported Fossil women's watch

items.label: ELEGANT DIAL
items.value: Round stainless steel case with white sunray dial and rose gold accents on this Fossil womens watch

items.label: CUSTOMIZED FIT
items.value: Genuine leather band with secure adjustable buckle for a tailored feel; interchangeable with all 14mm Fossil wrist watch straps

items.label: SPLASH-PROOF DURABILITY
items.value: This women's Fossil watch is Water Resistant: Up to 30m (100 ft): Will withstand splashes or brief immersion, but not suitable for swimming or showering; 3 ATM
